description:
Title: Developer Support Consultant
 Duration: 12 months
 Location: Atlanta, GA (Locals only) 

 Description:

 Consultant needed for periodic assignments where deep experience in the agencies technology platforms is required to resolve issues or provide software enhancements. The platforms and scope included under this agreement include:

Sharepoint 2013 support / C# Development
Development of custom C# code
Troubleshoot, debug, and fix existing custom developed code (HTML / C# / Java script) as required
Troubleshoot, debug, and fix existing installation and integrations as required
Developing code deployment scripts
Document support procedures


 Required skills needed to accomplish this assignment:

 · Candidate should have a good understanding of C# code as it pertains to SharePoint/MOSS, JavaScript, XML/XSLT, SharePoint forms server, SharePoint cascading style sheets.

· Candidate should be able to review existing code, determine errors and make corrections, use XSLT to style XML in web parts. Candidate should have an understanding of creating and customizing pages in SharePoint sites.

· Candidate should understand how to create and deploy SharePoint features.



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
